originals.citation: Burke, R. J., & Wilcox, D. S. (1969). Characteristics of effective employee performance review and development interviews. Personnel Psychology, 22(3), 291-305.

quote: Eight performance review interview characteristics were related to 7 interview outcomes. Several of these individual variables had been examined in previous research. ... replicating earlier research as well as adding new findings.
notes: Title is Burke & Wilcox (1969)'s title plus 'Replication and extension' (self-replication by Burke). Full text not accessed; other appraisal-interview studies (e.g., @nemeroff1977, @greller1975) may also be cited as earlier research on individual variables.
